2608.02663.title: CT-HEG: A Bidirectional, Timestamp-Attributed Event Graph for ICU In-Hospital Mortality Prediction - An Architectural Ablation Study
2608.02663.paper_summary: Accurate ICU mortality prediction requires modeling irregular clinical observations across heterogeneous entity types. Existing sequence models handle irregular sampling but ignore typed relational structure; existing graph models assume fixed-interval inputs. We introduce the Continuous-Time Heterogeneous EHR Graph (CT-HEG) schema and evaluate which architectural choices drive predictive performance. CT-HEG encodes each ICU stay as a typed, timestamped graph with three node types (visit, vital, lab_event) and 2D edge attributes (t_hours/48, value_norm) encoding timing and value without imputation. We instantiate CT-HEG as CHIRP-Net, a four-layer heterogeneous GATv2Conv network, evaluated on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (31,142 ICU stays, LOS>=48h, 13.4% mortality) with five seeds and bootstrapped confidence intervals, against logistic regression, mTAND, a Transformer, and GRU-D, plus an ablation study. CHIRP-Net achieved 5-seed mean AUROC 0.8449+/-0.0071 (AUPRC 0.4958+/-0.0209); the ensemble achieved AUROC 0.8618 (95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745). Removing reverse edges disconnected observation nodes from the visit readout, cutting AUROC by 0.1968+/-0.0073. Time-attentive edge features contributed 0.0247+/-0.0093 AUROC. Collapsing heterogeneous edge types into one relation (7x fewer parameters) outperformed the full model on all seeds. Post-calibration ECE was 0.0307. Temporal and demographic subgroup analyses were explored but not reported here, pending follow-up work. Bidirectional connectivity was necessary for the model to use its inputs at all, and CT-HEG was reasonably well calibrated after validation-fitted temperature scaling. These results support CT-HEG for irregular EHR data, while external validation, a pre-specified temporal evaluation, and a demographic fairness audit remain necessary before any claim of robustness. Code: https://github.com/nasiruddinstudents-ctrl/chirp-net-mimic-iv.
2608.02663.paper_summary_zh: 準確的 ICU 死亡率預測需要對異質實體類型中的不規則臨床觀察進行建模。現有的序列模型處理不規則取樣，但忽略了類型關係結構；現有的圖模型假設固定間隔的輸入。我們介紹了連續時間異質 EHR 圖（CT-HEG）架構，並評估哪些架構選擇驅動預測性能。CT-HEG 將每次 ICU 住院編碼為一個帶有三種節點類型（就診、生命體徵、實驗室事件）和 2D 邊緣屬性（t_hours/48、value_norm）的類型化時間戳圖，編碼時間和數值而不進行填補。我們將 CT-HEG 實例化為 CHIRP-Net，一個四層異質 GATv2Conv 網絡，在 MIMIC-IV v3.1（31,142 次 ICU 住院，LOS >= 48h，13.4% 死亡率）上進行評估，使用五個隨機種子和自助信心區間，與邏輯回歸、mTAND、一個 Transformer 和 GRU-D 進行比較，並進行了消融研究。CHIRP-Net 在 5 個隨機種子上達到了平均 AUROC 0.8449+/-0.0071（AUPRC 0.4958+/-0.0209）；集成模型達到了 AUROC 0.8618（95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745）。移除反向邊緣使觀察節點與就診讀出斷開，導致 AUROC 降低了 0.1968+/-0.0073。時間注意邊緣特徵貢獻了 0.0247+/-0.0093 AUROC。將異質邊緣類型合併為一個關係（參數減少 7 倍）在所有隨機種子上均優於完整模型。後校準的 ECE 為 0.0307。探索了時間和人口統計亞組分析，但此處未報告，待後續工作。雙向連接對於模型使用其輸入是必要的，並且 CT-HEG 在驗證擬合的溫度縮放後合理地進行了校準。這些結果支持 CT-HEG 用於不規則 EHR 數據，而外部驗證、預先指定的時間評估和人口公平性審計在任何穩健性聲明之前仍然是必要的。代碼：https://github.com/nasiruddinstudents-ctrl/chirp-net-mimic-iv。
